messages:
ravi (design): quick sync: proposal to treat left-rail links as either 'clean' or 'contextual' navigations. default click = clean (no filters carried). hold-click or menu = contextual (preserve filters + tab). avoids surprise state carry for new users. thoughts?

marta (ux): like the idea. need clear affordance. suggest a tiny down-caret menu on each section header: "Open (clean) / Open (preserve current view)". show toggle only when there are active filters.

hao (eng): implementation: urls remain canonical with query params. contextual nav will append current portable params when building href. for very long param sets we can generate a short token server-side `/s/abc123` and redirect to expanded view on load. tradeoffs: server storage vs client compression.

sam (frontend): UX detail: prefer client-side base64+lz compression for ephemeral shares so we don't need server storage. still provide server shortlinks for persistent saved views. also decide on pushState vs replaceState rules.

lina (product): telemetry: capture `nav_mode=clean|contextual` and `via=sidebar|breadcrumb|topbar`. want to see which users prefer contextual links. A/B test default for new users OFF.

ida (a11y): accessibility: when a contextual link rehydrates the page, announce via aria-live: "View restored: 4 filters applied" and move focus to the main heading. if a side-panel opens, focus heading inside panel. avoid unexpected jump for keyboard users.

ravi (design): breadcrumb behavior: default crumb click = go to parent clean view; crumb menu includes "Restore with filters". show a subtle dot next to crumb on hover when restore is available. copy for permalinks: use "Share exact view" not "Copy link".

hao (eng): edge-case: legacy deep links with only id should resolve: resolver tries to map id -> canonical context and then replaceState to canonical path with `resolved_from=legacy`. if resource missing, show resolver modal with options.

sam (frontend): action items: i'll draft a small RFC for link-building + history semantics, include aria copy. hao to prototype token service options. marta to mock the section header menu and crumb menu. lina to schedule A/B test. deploy-bot: can we get a staging rollout date?

deploy-bot: rollout scheduled: nav-clean-vs-contextual -> staging 2024-11-01T14:00Z :rocket:

ravi (design): thanks — sync in Thurs design review to sign off.
